import sys

def read_sum(left):
    if left <= 0:
        return 0
    value = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    return value + read_sum(left - 1)

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    total = read_sum(n)
    print(total // n)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
